subject.title: fix(fal): apply request policy to media generation requests

question: Is the controlled Fal-compatible provider-path transcript sufficient for this security-boundary change, or must the contributor provide redacted real FAL or representative external/private-network proof?
rationale: The patch appears correct and uses an established explicit opt-in contract, but OpenClaw policy requires live testing for external API work and the submitted evidence does not exercise the real external transport path.

options.title: Require representative network proof
options.body: Keep merge blocked until redacted evidence exercises real FAL or a representative proxy/private-network route and confirms the intended media-path scope.

options.title: Accept controlled provider proof
options.body: Explicitly override the live-proof requirement because the transcript exercises the normal provider path and the code only connects an established sanitized resolver.

recommendation.title: Require representative network proof
recommendation.body: Keep merge blocked until redacted evidence exercises real FAL or a representative proxy/private-network route and confirms the intended media-path scope.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and merged the shared request transport override contract whose intended security and compatibility scope controls this decision.
